Question: Are preoperative clinical parameters predictive of post-operative recurrence in patients undergoing surgery for pituitary adenoma?

Abstract:
The aim of this study was to determine the prognostic value of different parameters in patients with pituitary adenomas who had undergone transsphenoidal microsurgical tumour resection. We prospectively evaluated preoperative hormonal status, endocrine panels, and radiological findings in 104 consecutive cases and analyzed these data according to the post-operative recurrence rates for each tumor. In addition, we analyzed the relationship between the clinical factors of the patients with or without pituitary adenoma recurrences during a five year follow-up period. We found that there was no statistical difference in the clinical parameters of the patients with and those without post-operative recurrence except for pre-treatment tumour size (p=0.013). We conclude that preoperative tumor volume may predict recurrence rates following pituitary adenoma resection.
